stories.title: Sen. Sanders wants Americans to have a say — and stake — in the future of AI
stories.summary: Sen. Bernie Sanders talks with NPR's Juana Summers about his new legislation, which would create a sovereign wealth fund, and give the American people a say in regulating AI.

stories.title: Bagpipes, ticker-tape and a whole lot of joy as New Yorkers celebrate the Knicks
stories.summary: We take you to the big parade in New York City celebrating the New York Knicks, who won their first NBA championship in 53 years.

stories.title: Secretary of Defense Hegseth scolds NATO allies — again
stories.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth blasts NATO allies as a "paper tiger" while launching a six-month review of U.S. troop deployments in Europe and pressing for Europe to take the lead on its own defense.

stories.title: Birders are excited! A brown booby has landed in Kansas City
stories.summary: A tropical seabird way off course in deeply landlocked Kansas City has set off a birding frenzy. Even as the city hosts the World Cup, for some the most exotic visitor is a Brown booby.

stories.title: The DOJ is doling out local police grants — with a catch
stories.summary: The Justice Department is offering more than a billion dollars to cities and police departments across the U.S., but there's a catch: recipients must cooperate with federal immigration enforcement.

stories.title: In 'Toy Story 5,' tech has come to play
stories.summary: Three decades after Woody, Buzz Lightyear and pals debuted in Hollywood's first fully computer-animated feature, Pixar brings the whole gang back for a new adventure in Toy Story 5.
